decisions.decision: Expected ETag compare-and-swap loss retries until eventual promotion by default
decisions.rationale: A sibling publication is expected contention; every retry re-reads canonical and re-merges the original candidate, so failing after five wins caused false release failure.

decisions.decision: Premature markers from an unpublished batch are invalid evidence
decisions.rationale: The failed task wrote batch/accession markers before canonical silver promotion. Those exact versioned objects were quarantined and invalidated so resume could not skip unpublished data.
Missing EMPLOYED_BY source nodes are a real integrity failure; the failed candidate was not activated and gold refresh was not reached.

decisions.decision: Never redrive an execution after changing images
decisions.rationale: Step Functions redrive preserves old task-definition bindings; use a new execution name after each deployment.

decisions.decision: Production PASS requires the full chain plus the unchanged-watermark integrity rerun
decisions.rationale: BatchSilver, clean logs, or candidate parity alone are not release evidence.
